summary: For planktonic foraminifera the geometric part of the claim is data-ready: Zenodo 2593861 provides 42 micro-CT specimens with whole-test meshes and segmented per-chamber meshes (CC BY), supplemented by MorphoSource (75 foram CT media) and PANGAEA per-chamber tables. Nothing was found for desmids or for benthic Rotalia chambers, and no dataset documents the fluid-then-rigid formation of a chamber, so the mechanism clause and the desmid scope remain uncovered.
next_step: Pre-register a constant-mean-curvature fit on the chamber meshes versus the shrink-wrapped whole-test meshes of Zenodo 2593861; scout literature imaging of live chamber formation (e.g. Amphistegina/Ammonia culture studies) separately.
obstacles_confirmed: Desmid coverage is limited (no repository hits).
Rigid shells record final rather than fluid chamber geometry.
Desmids and many benthic chambered forms are outside this image set.
